requirements.body: The system shall initialize Docker Swarm via `swarm init --task-history-limit 1` on first boot if no Swarm state exists.
The system shall start coreapps in the order pihole, npm, cubeos-api, cubeos-dashboard, cubeos-hal, dozzle, network-layer, ai-layer, user apps.
The system shall not start any user-facing coreapp before pihole is healthy.
The system shall not start cubeos-api before the SQLite database initializes.
When `/cubeos/data/.setup_complete` is absent, the system shall mark the boot as first-boot.
When `/cubeos/data/.setup_complete` is present, the system shall classify the boot as recovery-boot and restore all coreapps to their last-known state.
If a coreapp fails to start during recovery, then the system shall record the failure to `/cubeos/data/boot.log` and continue with the remaining coreapps.
While the system is running, the watchdog daemon shall pet `/dev/watchdog` every 5 seconds with a hardware timeout of 15 seconds.
If the kernel hangs for more than 15 seconds without watchdog pet, then the hardware shall reset the board.
If the SQLite database is corrupted on boot, then the system shall attempt restoration from `/cubeos/data/backups/cubeos.db.last-known-good` and log the restoration event.
The system shall write a structured boot summary to `/cubeos/data/audit.log` on every successful boot completion.
